title: Map enterprise planning and decision platforms
accept: Distinguish vendor claims from implementation evidence for DIOS, o9, Maestro, Blue Yonder, SAP, Siemens, Oracle and Foundry. Record integration, scenarios and undisclosed limits.

title: Compare optimizers and modeling languages
accept: Compare AIMMS, Gurobi, Xpress, CPLEX, OR-Tools, Timefold, Hexaly, Pyomo, JuMP, MiniZinc and OptaPlanner by abstraction, license and capabilities.

title: Map optimization science and computational limits
accept: Cover every method in section 4.2 with assumptions, complexity, memory, guarantees and integration priority. Include a relationship diagram.

title: Review prior art, publications and patent claims
accept: Compare component reuse, IR lowering and algorithm selection with published precedents. Record identifiers, overlap and unknowns.

title: Model pilot economics and select verticals
accept: Score manufacturing against other verticals. Expose cost inputs, delivery assumptions and a falsifiable buyer hypothesis.

title: Validate demand and pilot data with a design partner
accept: Obtain authorized anonymized data, planner baseline, signed metric definitions and buying feedback. Keep customer records outside git.

title: Qualify native adapters and redistribution
accept: Run pinned OR-Tools and HiGHS fixtures on Windows and Linux. Inventory native components, ABI, notices and transitive licenses. Assess SCIP, Math.NET and ML.NET separately.

title: Approve the phase-zero evidence dossier
accept: Review source gaps, solver claims and product scope. Record go, revise or stop before releasing production software.

title: Publish system boundaries and architecture decisions
accept: Diagram component ownership, compare deployment alternatives, describe storage and UI decisions and extraction triggers.

title: Establish contributor intake and coordination
accept: Publish English and Arabic entry points, claim protocol, isolated worktrees, PR checklist and contract-owner policy.

title: Build cross-platform validation pipeline
accept: Run portable research checks on Linux and Windows. Surface reproducible commands and failures on pull requests.

title: Design tenant threat model and trust boundaries
accept: Review imports, plugins, cache isolation, identity, evidence export and system-of-record writes. Define defensive tests.

title: Version API, schema and extension contracts
accept: Publish compatibility policy with a backward-compatible extension, breaking migration example and rejection fixtures.

title: Define revisioned entity and hyperedge graph
accept: Represent all named EDG concepts and interval, capacity and provenance relationships. Show multi-variable constraint scopes.

title: Index dependencies and impact across revisions
accept: Compare incremental reachability to complete traversal including deleted and newly introduced edges and global objectives.

title: Implement typed UDIR and source spans
accept: Encode domains, rational literals, units, currencies, time basis, uncertainty, requirements and semantic versions. Round-trip fixtures.

title: Validate dimensions, calendars and currency conversion
accept: Reject implicit currency conversion, inconsistent time bases and overflow. Accept an explicit versioned rate and exact scale.

title: Specify DML grammar, AST and diagnostics
accept: Parse valid and invalid examples with spans and stable error codes. Define grammar extension rules for scenarios and triggers.

title: Build bounded declarative parser and binder
accept: Reject unknown symbols, cycles in derived expressions, excessive input and arbitrary executable constructs.

title: Implement semantic analysis and normalization
accept: Normalize equivalent exact expressions, retain provenance and compare finite feasible sets before and after transformation.

title: Implement capability-checked solver lowering
accept: Reject unsupported requirements and rounding. Map native indices to source constraints and distinguish exact from approximate transformations.

title: Expose typed C# modeling SDK
accept: Construct a production and workforce model with no strings for unit arithmetic. Compare normalized IR with DML equivalents.

title: Deliver JSON Schema and versioned model import
accept: Validate domain and schema separately. Reject unknown mandatory semantics, malformed bounds and duplicate keys.

title: Implement immutable model registry and provenance
accept: Persist tenant-scoped model revisions, source hashes and snapshots. Resolve old revisions after schema migration.

title: Implement safe presolve and transformation ledger
accept: Check tautologies, duplicates, unused variables and empty domains; preserve reconstruction metadata and counterexamples.

title: Define solver capability and result contracts
accept: Separate mathematical status, termination reason, incumbent, bounds, tolerances, trust source and resource use.

title: Integrate integer scheduling adapter
accept: Solve a precedence and no-overlap fixture using CP-SAT; preserve domain bounds, horizon semantics and native status.

title: Integrate LP and MILP adapter
accept: Solve and independently check LP and integer fixtures via HiGHS; handle native failures and unsupported certificates.

title: Implement independent feasibility and cost checker
accept: Check original-model assignments, integrality, intervals, capacities and every objective without calling the lowering layer.

title: Validate bounds and classify evidence strength
accept: Reject wrong-direction and stale bounds. Reproduce a primal/dual or enumeration proof; distinguish solver attestation.

title: Implement capability-first solver planning
accept: Filter by semantics then choose an eligible algorithm using features, budget and a documented tie-break; explain rejections.

title: Govern worker CPU, memory, queues and deadlines
accept: Exercise quotas with competing tenants, solver subprocess crashes, cancellation and timeouts without leaking leases.

title: Implement budgeted solver portfolio
accept: Charge cumulative core-seconds, cap concurrent native threads and compare equal-budget single solver runs.

title: Enable compatible hints and solver switching
accept: Map hints to the current revision, discard invalid bounds and stop workers on budget expiry, retaining best verified incumbent.

title: Persist evidence, lineage and audit reports
accept: Export input hash, solver version, termination, tolerances, verifier, hardware, timestamps and reproducible invocation.

title: Implement decision state machine and approval policies
accept: Test each allowed and forbidden transition; bind sensitive approvals to verified immutable revisions with separation of duties.

title: Expose REST API and idempotent job worker
accept: Submit, poll, cancel and replay a job with tenant isolation and idempotency conflict detection; publish OpenAPI.

title: Run exhaustive separability and reuse experiment
accept: Compare full enumeration with component reuse after a local change, then test shared capacities, coupled objectives and stale cache inputs.

title: Detect exact components and certify separability
accept: Check complete constraint and objective scopes, including implicit global resources; reconstruct a verified solution from independent components.

title: Produce canonical fingerprints and reuse permissions
accept: Separate structure, data, constraints, objectives and solver config; exercise deletion, reordered input, tenant and compiler version.

title: Validate cache entries and prevent stale bound reuse
accept: Replay changed units, objectives, adapter versions and data. Cache misses or revalidation must preserve evidence strength.

title: Implement bounded repair and full-solve fallback
accept: Treat fixed-boundary solutions as feasible unless certified. Re-expand on failed verification, crossing constraints or insufficient quality.

title: Evaluate separators, SCCs and coordinated decomposition
accept: Contrast SCCs with primal incidence components. Test Benders or pricing only for structures satisfying documented assumptions.

title: Build reproducible benchmark harness and corpus
accept: Record seed, dataset license, hardware, warm/cold setup, wall time, core seconds, peak RSS, gap and timeout censoring.

title: Evaluate incremental and portfolio hypotheses
accept: Compare cold full, hinted full, component reuse and repair under matched budgets; publish failures, confidence intervals and ablations.

title: Evaluate learned selection against deterministic policy
accept: Hold out instance families; include feature extraction overhead and single-best baseline. Disable ML unless acceptance threshold holds.

title: Maintain innovation register and stop decisions
accept: Record prior art, proof assumptions, benchmark results, failure regions and novelty status per hypothesis.

title: Specify manufacturing datasets and optimization model
accept: Define machine calendars, materials, precedence, release dates, due dates and cost units. Hand-check at least one optimum.

title: Implement deterministic dispatch baseline
accept: Provide earliest-due-date baseline with stable tie-break and explicit failure for infeasible material or calendar assignments.

title: Implement finite-capacity production scheduling
accept: Output a checkable schedule with finite materials, machines, deadlines and weighted tardiness. Explain any infeasible fixture.

title: Deliver outage and demand-change scenarios
accept: Branch immutable inputs for machine downtime and changed demand. Compare lateness, cost and stability using the same units.

title: Validate pilot against planner historical schedule
accept: Replay an agreed horizon, expose all exclusions and measure verified outcomes against planner and dispatch baselines.

title: Specify independent workforce coverage model
accept: Encode shifts, skills and capacity with cost and coverage, using no manufacturing dependencies.

title: Demonstrate core reuse across sectors
accept: Run workforce fixtures including infeasible coverage. Identify reused contracts and domain-specific code by dependency checks.

title: Define connector SDK and mapping manifests
accept: Specify field type, unit, provenance, mapping version, cursor, retries, reconciliation and credentials by reference.

title: Implement CSV and JSON snapshot import
accept: Test encoding, decimal conventions, errors per row, repeat ingestion and reversed input order.

title: Implement REST ingestion and authenticated webhooks
accept: Test duplicate delivery, ordering gaps, replay, pagination and retry ceilings using fake peers.

title: Implement incremental sync, recovery and health
accept: Persist cursor atomically with writes, recover after process failure, quarantine invalid data and report freshness.

title: Deliver optional WOW ERP connector
accept: Provide sandbox contract fixtures, mapped fields and opt-in scopes. Core tests must pass with the adapter absent.

title: Qualify SAP, Oracle and Dynamics adapters
accept: For each vendor pin the supported API, mapping and replay contract; require authorized sandbox evidence before enabling.

title: Qualify Odoo, ERPNext and custom ERP adapters
accept: Exercise independent versioned field mappings and cursor reconciliation per platform; publish adapter capability sheets.

title: Add SQL, Excel and event-stream adapters
accept: Test read-only queries, workbook data types, offsets and replay semantics. Reject invalid units and partial snapshots.

title: Qualify CRM, MES, WMS and IoT feeds
accept: Validate freshness, event IDs, clock skew and schema revisions per source with recorded non-customer fixtures.

title: Implement immutable scenario comparison
accept: Compare baseline and scenario on matched units and horizon, distinguishing changed inputs from output differences.

title: Explain decisions, alternatives and conflicts
accept: Report objective decomposition, binding constraints and a forced alternative re-solve. Distinguish IIS from minimum repair.

title: Implement LP sensitivity and relaxation analysis
accept: Restrict dual prices to valid LP assumptions and ranges. Verify discrete alternatives by re-solving.

title: Add discrete-event and Monte Carlo simulation
accept: Validate queue dynamics on a deterministic fixture and reject biased causal claims from simulated trials.

title: Model forecast uncertainty and risk
accept: Backtest prediction intervals, robust sets and stochastic plans with held-out scenarios; report coverage and downside metrics.

title: Add verified advisory recommendations and optional MCP
accept: Recommendations reference verified evidence. Test read-only scoped MCP access and operation without an LLM or paid service.

title: Ship cross-platform professional CLI
accept: Provide validate, compile, solve, compare and evidence commands with stable JSON, human tables, cancellation and exit codes.

title: Qualify Microsoft Blazor desktop delivery
accept: Test installable window, offline startup, keyboard navigation, RTL and packaging on Windows and Linux. Document host ownership.

title: Build visual modeling studio and graph explorer
accept: Round-trip typed model edits, show source-linked hyperedges and prevent invalid saves.

title: Build scheduling and scenario workspace
accept: Show resource usage, timeline, alternatives and changed constraints. Test keyboard and screen-reader flows.

title: Build evidence viewer and benchmark dashboard
accept: Display solver and verifier statuses separately, export reproducible evidence, surface unknown gaps and censored runs.

title: Build administration and developer portals
accept: Exercise tenant roles, connector health, schemas, SDK examples and audit search using a least-privilege account.

title: Implement tenant-aware identity and authorization
accept: Authenticate through OIDC, bind jobs to tenant, reject cross-tenant lookups and audit denied access without secrets.

title: Persist models and jobs with EF Core
accept: Exercise PostgreSQL migrations, tenant keys, concurrent revision writes and backup restore. Document SQL Server portability differences.

title: Implement outbox, scheduling and notifications
accept: Crash between commit and publish, replay duplicate events and show a single logical notification with bounded retries.

title: Implement human approvals and gated external execution
accept: Require authorized approval for a verified revision and single logical execution; stale approvals and ambiguous side effects fail closed.

title: Add telemetry, audit retention and operations tools
accept: Trace model-to-run without exposing customer input; verify retention, redaction, restore drills and per-tenant cost attribution.

title: Package self-hosted Docker and SaaS profiles
accept: Smoke-test air-gapped install and hosted configuration, upgrade/rollback with data compatibility and secret rotation.

title: Isolate extension code and native workers
accept: Run plugins out of process with explicit permissions; test resource limits, process expiry and fail-closed startup.

title: Implement scale-out queue and resource fairness
accept: Exercise competing tenants, duplicate workers, lease expiry and overload; publish throughput and fairness by workload.

title: Add compiler property and differential tests
accept: Generate bounded models and compare original, normalized and lowered feasible assignments, objectives and diagnostic spans.

title: Run integration, accessibility and isolation tests
accept: Cover CLI and desktop workflows, RTL, tenant isolation, backup and approval bypass denial using synthetic records.

title: Publish release evidence and licensing inventory
accept: Produce checksums, dependency inventory, notices, supported OS matrix, operator guide and reproducible release checklist.

title: Decide MVP, enterprise and scale release gates
accept: Map measured results to gates, document exclusions and decide release independently at each tier.

title: Evaluate expansion across proposed sectors
accept: Score inventory, logistics, transport, retail, health, finance, cash flow, energy, construction, projects, agriculture, telecom, cloud and data centers by data availability, risk and value before opening delivery epics.
